The '''Meirm Bandingo''' was a truncated [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] model produced by the [[Meirm Speeder Emporium]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
